feature: Remove trigger phrase collisions between experiment-workflow and experiment-report
problem: skill-suggest.py uses whole-word phrase matching. 'write findings' appears verbatim in both experiment-workflow and experiment-report descriptions, causing both skills to be suggested when a user types 'write findings'. The workflow skill owns the execution phase (setup, run, analyze); the report skill owns the output phase (write report, findings). The phrase belongs only in experiment-report.
proposed_solution: Remove 'write findings' from experiment-workflow's 'Use when:' section. No other trigger is a true collision (analyze results, create EXPERIMENT.md, etc. are unique to workflow; benchmark report, performance report, etc. are unique to report). Apply change to both library/cursor/ and .cursor/ (synced copies).
acceptance_criteria: grep 'write findings' library/cursor/skills/experiment-report/SKILL.md returns at least 1 match (trigger preserved in the right skill)

python3 library/cursor/hooks/skill-suggest.py --skills-dir .cursor/skills --prompt 'write findings' --format json returns only experiment-report, not experiment-workflow (verified by: names=[s['name'] for s in r['skill_suggestions']]; assert 'experiment-report' in names and 'experiment-workflow' not in names)
python3 library/cursor/hooks/skill-suggest.py --skills-dir .cursor/skills --prompt 'set up experiment' --format json still returns experiment-workflow (no regression on workflow-specific triggers)
diff library/cursor/skills/experiment-workflow/SKILL.md .cursor/skills/experiment-workflow/SKILL.md exits 0 (files are byte-for-byte identical after sync)
edge_cases: experiment-workflow still has 'analyze results' as a unique trigger — verify python3 library/cursor/hooks/skill-suggest.py --skills-dir .cursor/skills --prompt 'analyze results' --format json returns experiment-workflow and NOT experiment-report (no new collision introduced)

Removing 'write findings' must not malform the 'Use when:' clause — verified by: grep -P 'Use when:.*,\s*"' library/cursor/skills/experiment-workflow/SKILL.md exits 1 (no trailing comma before closing quote); grep -P 'Use when:.*,,\s*' library/cursor/skills/experiment-workflow/SKILL.md exits 1 (no double comma)
verification_method: grep -c 'write findings' library/cursor/skills/experiment-workflow/SKILL.md (expect 0); diff library/cursor/skills/experiment-workflow/SKILL.md .cursor/skills/experiment-workflow/SKILL.md (expect exit 0); python3 library/cursor/hooks/skill-suggest.py --skills-dir .cursor/skills --prompt 'write findings' --format json | python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); names=[s['name'] for s in r['skill_suggestions']]; assert 'experiment-report' in names and 'experiment-workflow' not in names, f'FAIL: {names}'; print('PASS')"
